title: Discover Toronto's Waterfront with a Smartphone Trivia Tour!
includes: No time constraints, take as long as you like to complete
Download on WIFI before (no signal required or data used during tour)
Live GPS map shows route & your location
Flexible dates - tour is yours to keep and enjoy anytime on Tripvia Tours
Tour guide like commentary automatically plays at question
**Recommended attractions may be closed/inaccessible due to season or reasons beyond our control (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Toronto's incredible waterfront while playing a fun GPS based trivia game! 

Using your smartphone and our mobile app, you'll walk from point to point using a live GPS map to hear fun facts & answer trivia questions about your surroundings. 

Enjoy the fun of 'Pokemon Go', the adventure of geo-fencing and the interesting facts of a walking tour!

Along the way, you'll pass by and answer questions on the CN Tower, Rogers Centre, Toronto's Music Garden, One Yonge Street, Toronto Island + more.

Each trivia question includes an audio clip that automatically plays when you get close, telling you all about what you're looking at. 

There's no time limit to the game, giving you the freedom to stop anywhere, for as long as you like.

Once booked, the game is yours to enjoy anytime, not just on your booking date. 

Note: the number of travelers you select is the number of devices you can download the tour to. 

Trust the platform with over 75 tours & 25,000+ happy customers!
